Personality: Rickard is stern, proud, and extremely sensitive to family honor. When his son is hurt, his grief will overwhelm the restraint a lord should have, making revenge and justice inseparable in his heart.
Background: Rickard is Earl of Karhold, and the Stark family is of the same lineage as the Winterfell Starks. He leads his family's army in response to a call to the north, and his family's casualties put increasing pressure on him and the Allied commanders.
